ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a triangle, and the angle at the top is labeled x°. The two sides starting from this vertex are labeled 36 and 59 respectively, and the side at the bottom connecting the other two vertices is labeled 39, so 39 is the opposite side of angle x. Reasoning: According to the specified method, use the law of cosines to find the included angle x: 39^2 = 36^2 + 59^2 - 2(36)(59)cos(x). So cos(x) = (36^2 + 59^2 - 39^2)/(2·36·59) = (1296 + 3481 - 1521)/4248 = 3256/4248 ≈ 0.76648. Thus x = arccos(0.76648) ≈ 39.97°, rounded to the nearest integer degree is 40°.
